title: Skills
empty: No skill yet. Describe a task to start.

start.title: Describe your task
start.subtitle: Tell it like you would to a new colleague: what you do, when, with which files or systems, and what a good result looks like. The assistant will ask questions until it has understood everything.
start.skillTitle: Give this skill a short name
start.description: How do you do this task today?
start.placeholder: Every Monday I open the supplier invoices spreadsheet, check the amounts against the purchase orders in the ERP, flag anything over budget and email the list to accounting…

interview.title: Interview
interview.completeBody: The knowledge document is frozen and the skill memory has been written. The next step is drafting the skill.

knowledge.title: What I understood so far
knowledge.criteria: What a good result looks like

memory.title: Skill memory
memory.subtitle: Rationale, business needs, how you do it today, technical and integration notes. Kept for whoever maintains this skill.
memory.empty: No memory yet. Notes are added automatically after the interview and during trials.

dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.subtitle: Files, spreadsheets, mailboxes, systems that the tasks in this project use. The interviewer references them.
dataSources.name: Name
dataSources.access: Where it is and how to open it

providers.title: AI providers
providers.subtitle: Local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM) or cloud models used by the interviewer, author and supervisor.
providers.name: Name
providers.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty for local servers.
providers.empty: No provider configured. Interviews need one.

versions.generating: Drafting started, this takes a minute…
versions.instructionsPlaceholder: Be stricter about…, rename step…, add a check for…

library.title: Component library
library.subtitle: Ancillary skills and MCP servers provided by the administrator. The author reuses them instead of re-implementing integrations (email, directories, databases…).
library.name: Name
library.sourceHint: Uploaded packages are served by this server in every install bundle; other sources are referenced by URL or package name.

trials.title: Trials on your agent
trials.subtitle: The skill is installed temporarily on your own agent and machine. Every step waits for your decision here: explain, preview with real data, discuss, change, redo, approve.
trials.intro: Choose the agent and how the trial runs. Nothing runs on the server: your agent executes the skill on your machine and reports each step here.

modeHint.interactive: Recommended: the agent pauses at every step until you decide.
modeHint.async: For agents whose tool timeout is too short; steps are recorded and you review them after.

trials.createdHelp: Run the command on your machine (after `pipx install autoskill-local` and `autoskill login`), or hand the online address below to your agent: it can download and install everything by itself.
trials.tokenWarning: The command contains a one-time trial token: do not share it.
trials.waitingInstallHelp: Run the CLI command or install manually with the guide below, then start the task in your agent.
trials.waitingAgent: Waiting for the agent to reach the next step… start the task in your agent.
trials.suspendedBanner: This trial is suspended. The trial copy stays installed; resume whenever you want.
trials.reviewHelp: When you have seen enough, ask for a summary and decide: accept (keep or remove the copy), request changes (a new version is drafted from your corrections), major rework, or remove.
trials.finishedHelp: This trial is finished: {{outcome}}. Use the CLI to keep or remove the copy: autoskill trial accept/remove.
trials.irreversibleWarning: This step is irreversible. In a trial it is only simulated: check the exact effect the agent describes. Real execution always requires your explicit authorization.
trials.authorizeConfirm: Authorize the agent to really execute this irreversible step now?

decisions.approve_and_authorize_next: Approve and go to the next step

trials.changeLabel: What should the agent do differently?
trials.changeHint: Sent to the agent as the new instruction for this step; the skill text is updated too.
trials.discussPlaceholder: Ask the coach or describe what is wrong…
trials.applied: Change applied: the agent will redo the step with the new instruction.
trials.noneHelp: Draft a version, then try it on your agent.
trials.bundleUrlHint: Anyone with this address can download the installation description and every component it cites (skill, MCP servers, shared components) without logging in, until the trial is closed. It does not contain the trial token.
trials.tellAgentText: Install the AutoSkill skill described at {{url}} (machine-readable manifest: {{manifest}}). Download every component from the addresses given there, verify the checksums, register the MCP servers and ask me for the environment values and the trial token.

runs.title: Runs
runs.select: Select a run to see its steps.

review.queueHelp: Versions waiting for a reviewer before they can be published to the hub.

lifecycle.submitHelp: A reviewer (admin or super user) will check the changes, the trial results and the install docs before this version can be published.
lifecycle.summary: What changed and why (for the reviewer)
lifecycle.publishHelp: Publishing makes this version installable from the hub and notifies people who installed a previous version. Only a person can authorize it.
lifecycle.deprecateHelp: Deprecating removes this version from the hub as the current one. Installed copies keep working until updated.

checks.reviewed_diff: I reviewed the changes and the reviewer's comments
checks.trial_accepted: It was tested on a real agent and accepted
checks.install_docs_checked: The installation guide is correct for the target agents
checks.installers_notified: People who installed it have been informed

hub.title: Skill Hub
hub.subtitle: Skills shared by everyone on this AutoSkill. Try one on your agent before installing it, or make your own variant.
hub.emptyHelp: Skills appear here once a version is reviewed and published with visibility shared or public.
hub.forkHelp: Copies the published version into one of your projects as a private draft (steps, files and memory included) so you can adapt and test it for yourself.
hub.forkNoProject: You need a project where you are editor or owner.
hub.installHelp: With the CLI (recommended) or by downloading the package and following the guide.
hub.settingsHelp: Who can see this skill once a version is published, and how it is classified.

visibilities.public: Public (also without login, if the hub is public)

visibilityHelp.shared: All users of this AutoSkill can find, try and install it.
visibilityHelp.public: Also visible without an account when the administrator enables the public hub.

installs.title: My installs
installs.subtitle: Skills you installed from the hub, with update alerts.

mcp.help: {{count}} deterministic steps can become MCP tools: predictable, testable, and they save model calls at run time.
mcp.noneHelp: Generate one; the author model writes each tool from the step, code adds dry-run and confirmation guards, static checks block unsafe code.
mcp.noDeterministic: This version has no deterministic steps.
mcp.checkHelp: Nothing runs on the server. Download the package, then run this command: it installs the server in a temporary environment, lists the tools and runs the smoke tests, and reports the result here.
mcp.checkOk: Checked on your machine: {{count}} tools available.

improvements.title: Improvements
improvements.subtitle: AutoSkill watches failed runs, reported issues and trial corrections. When there is enough evidence it drafts a corrected version with a rationale. Nothing is published without you: accepted proposals still go through a trial, review and your authorization.
improvements.nothing: No failures, issues or corrections recorded for this version.
improvements.noneHelp: Proposals appear automatically after 3 failed runs or 2 issues, or when you ask for one.
improvements.decideHelp: Accepting keeps the proposed version as a draft to trial and stores the lessons in the skill memory. Rejecting discards it.

links.title: Online install links
links.hint: Create an address from which your agent (or anyone you give it to) can download INSTALL.md, install.json and every artifact without logging in. Links expire and can be revoked.
links.publicHint: This skill is public on a public hub: the addresses in the guide work without a token. You can still create a private link with its own expiry.
links.agentHint: Tell your agent: “install the skill described at this address”.
links.label: Label
